notes: NAME-COLLISION HANDLED EXPLICITLY. A separate doctor, Dr. Arjun Reddy K, is also a CARE Hospitals Hyderabad neurosurgeon and surfaced repeatedly in the same result sets - his page is https://www.carehospitals.com/doctor/hyderabad/care-super-specialty-hospital-musheerabad/arjun-reddy-k-neurosurgeon , i.e. a DIFFERENT given name (Arjun vs Arun), a different trailing initial (K vs M) and a DIFFERENT branch (Musheerabad vs HITEC City). Nothing from the Arjun Reddy K pages has been used here, and nothing from this row should be applied to him. BRANCH MATCH REQUIRED AND MET: because the input row carried no experience figure, I required the CARE branch to match explicitly before accepting anything. It does - CARE's own domain returned a per-doctor page titled 'Dr. Arun Reddy M | Best Spine Specialist in HITEC City, Hyderabad | CARE Hospitals' at https://www.carehospitals.com/doctor/hyderabad/hitec-city/arun-reddy-m , with the branch encoded in the URL path, and three separate CARE 'Doctor Speak' pages independently label him 'Dr. Arun Reddy M | CARE Hospitals, HITEC City'. That is name + trailing initial + specialty + hospital + branch + city all matching on the hospital's own site. NOT an index-coverage gap and NOT a stale affiliation: CARE publishes a live per-doctor page for him at the exact branch given in the input row, so hospital_profile is populated. CARE SLUG NOTE: this doctor's /doctor/ URL uses the bare branch slug 'hitec-city' while the /doctor-list/ family uses the verbose 'care-hospital-hi-tech-city' (and note 'CARE Hospitals Outpatient Centre Hi-Tech City' is a separate branch again) - the same slug divergence the brief documents for Banjara Hills. One CARE page (a 'Doctor Speak' item on brain tumours) attaches his name to 'CARE Hospitals, Nampally'; I have not recorded Nampally as a practice location since it appears once, in a media-item slug only, and conflicts with the consistent HITEC City labelling everywhere else - worth a human glance if branch precision matters. PHONE DISCARDED AFTER EXACT-PHRASE CHECK: two search summaries asserted '+91-40-68106529' as the way to book him, including one sourced from his own clinic site. I re-searched the string in quotes and it resolves to CARE Hospitals HITEC City's own switchboard - it is carried on https://www.carehospitals.com/contact-us/care-hospital-hi-tech-city and the HITEC City hospital-detail and contact pages, i.e. a central hospital line, not his personal or dedicated clinic line. Section 4 bars recording a hospital switchboard as a doctor's own number, so professional_phone is left BLANK. No email for him appeared verbatim anywhere and none was constructed from the carehospitals.com or indineurocare.com domains. FACEBOOK NOT RECORDED IN THE facebook FIELD: a search result titled 'Indi Spine Brain Neuro Care | Hyderabad' points at https://www.facebook.com/AsianSpineBrainNeuroCare/ , but the page slug ('AsianSpineBrainNeuroCare') does not match the clinic name, which suggests a renamed or repurposed page. I have logged the URL verbatim in other_profiles with that caveat rather than asserting it as his verified clinic channel. BAND: Medium, not High. Only ONE section-5 official source backs this (carehospitals.com - all the CARE doctor, doctor-list, doctor-speak and contact pages are one domain and therefore one source). His own clinic site indineurocare.com corroborates strongly and is the best ownership evidence, but per section 5 a doctor's own site is primary self-published, not independent, so it cannot earn High. Everything else returned (Credihealth, HexaHealth, Skedoc, Practo, myUpchar, Medsurge India) is corroborating-only.
